comment: The one producer of every sysinit state path. Nix reads this and emits the paths manifest; a box with no Nix expands it with $HOME and gets the same file. Every path is spelled in full rather than composed from stateHome, because the only substitution allowed here is $HOME, and a second pass would make the expander something a shell one-liner cannot be. See modules/shared/options/paths.nix.
